function.name: math_triangle_area_heron
function.description: Calculates the area of a triangle using Heron's formula, given the lengths of its three sides. Unlike math_triangle_area_base_height, which calculates the area of a triangle from base and height, this calculates the area of a triangle using Heron's formula.

side1.description: Length of the first side of the triangle.

side2.description: Length of the second side of the triangle.

side3.description: Length of the third side of the triangle.

function.name: math_circle_area
function.description: Calculates the area of a circle given its radius. Unlike math_triangle_area_heron, which calculates the area of a triangle, this calculates the area of a circle.

radius.description: The radius of the circle. This is a float type value.

function.name: math_triangle_area_base_height
function.description: Calculates the area of a triangle using the formula (1/2)base*height. Unlike math_triangle_area_heron, which calculates the area of a triangle using Heron's formula, this calculates the area of a triangle from base and height.

base.description: The base length of the triangle. This is a float type value.

height.description: The height of the triangle. This is a float type value.
